blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Determined to keep Akari winning, Eli Soyud unconsciously poured in 30 points in familiar territory at Ninoy Aquino Stadium, where she once had her heroics in the previous PVL All-Filipino Conference. Last March, Soyud nailed the telling blows to lead Akari past Choco Mucho in a play-in game at the same venue. This time, she willed Akari back to outlast Farm Fresh, 25-22, 25-27, 22-25, 25-23, 15-12, for its second straight win in the Siklab Series on Tuesday. “Actually, I had no idea I had scored 30 points.
